name: Workyard Upstairs Workstation Family v1 — Concept Fidelity
subtitle: Purposeful survival workstation, storage, mugs, bucket and repaired stool
review_note: The Blender family preserves the irregular three-plank pegged workbench, splayed trestles, arranged hatchet/whetstone/wedges/mallet/pitch pot, stepped crockery hutch, blue-rimmed plates, hanging mug shelf, visibly open stave bucket with handle, repaired stool, and the concept's readable player-relative scale. It remains an original Crafted Realm construction with flatter 2007-era materials.
improve: Keep the work surface at 1.10 tiles and cabinet at 2.82; do not enlarge the bucket, mugs, or stool under runtime lighting.
